model: HybridBathNet only; all modules jointly optimized
uncertainty: Detach variance input features and NLL mean; variance trains only its head. Huber mean/physics gradients preserved; not the exact MSE faithfulness theorem.
physics_change: Per-band effective K shared across valid patch water; albedo remains per pixel. This reduces flexibility but does not identify physical Kd without external calibration.
comparison: One predeclared joint candidate versus frozen nearshore v1; no test tuning or mask
rinf_caveat: Training 2nd percentile is retained only for matched comparison, not certified deep-water background
test_regions: original block IDs retained; denser distinct shallow coordinates
selection: validation RMSE on 0–20m; test examined after training only
test_20_to_25m: extrapolation beyond supervised training depth, sensitivity only
optical_limit: heuristic flag only, not an exclusion mask
augmentation: spectral jitter, flips; optical reconstruction targets remain unjittered
warning: Overlapping patches and coarse GEBCO are not independent 10m survey truths.
